authority: SF21: ONE scientific variable vs SF20: add paired counterfactual representation consistency term

kl.support: full 1024-class softmax/log-softmax of untied language head logits
kl.student_mode: eval (dropout off) with grad enabled; teacher eval + torch.no_grad; then m.train() for factual CE
kl.precision: float64 accumulation over the 160 selected positions; mean; cast scalar to float32
kl.applied_on: English factual updates only (updates of kind 'english', sequential index 1..180)
kl.teacher: separate DaveLMV082 build_model('untied') loaded from parent base_model.* keys; eval; requires_grad_(False); never in optimizer; no shared Parameter/storage with student

consistency_term.description: Paired counterfactual representation consistency - ONE scientific variable vs SF20
consistency_term.representation_target: logits at position = prefix_length - 1 (last context token before answer generation)
consistency_term.normalization: L2 normalization of representation vectors before cosine similarity
consistency_term.loss_form: mean(1 - cos_sim(v_i, v_j)) over all positive pairs in the English batch
consistency_term.pairing_rule: Records grouped by pair_id from TRAIN.json; each pair_id has exactly 2 records with same template, different identities

d3.parent_specific_reference: U0 D3 reproduction is per SF20 branch, keyed by parent checkpoint sha256. No averaged baseline.

gates.endpoint: correct==16 AND exact==16 AND reversals==8 AND families==4
gates.binding_stop: any pool answer<76 OR BD<76 OR collapse>0 at update 100 or 200
gates.acquisition_guard_update100: if (correct < 10) AND (exact < 10): STOP (additive; does not weaken any gate)

schedule: 200 updates = 20 x (9 English + 1 binding); SF13 SCHEDULE.json (read-only); English batch = 36 records; 180 English + 20 binding.
optimizer: fresh AdamW lr 5e-5 betas(0.9,0.999) eps1e-8 wd0.05 amsgrad=False foreach=False fused=False; clip 2.0; one step/update
scope: English: every base_model param except base_model.blocks.{0..3}; binding: full. (PINNED_MASKING.set_scope)
transfer_panels: HELDOUT16/ALTERNATE48/COPY8/COMPETING64 remain LOCKED/UNSCORED; opened only if endpoint + language + binding pass at 200; FINAL/sacred never accessed
evals: rolling restart every update; permanent checkpoints + full evaluation at updates 0/100/200; D3 diagnostic at 0/100/200
notes: SF21: ONE scientific variable vs SF20: add paired counterfactual representation consistency term (lambda=0.1).

All other parameters frozen: SF20 curriculum (48 records: 16 TRAIN16 + 32 widening with 16-name set), identities, schedule (200 updates), factual CE, lambda_margin=0.25, M=1.0, lambda_KL=1.0, LR=5e-5, optimizer, binding rehearsal, frozen gates.
